payload.claim: A handful of the Notes/Witnesses section's inline path:line citations drift by one to a few lines from the literal source location of the quoted text or construct (e.g., _probe_agent's body is quoted as :1244-1260 where the def line is 1243; _apply_criterion_probes's 'this session named no edit' branch is quoted as :1987-1989 where it is at 1988). In every case checked, the quoted content and described behavior were still correct, only the line pointer was off by a line or two, so this doesn't affect what the cell would build, just a reader's ability to jump to the exact line.
